local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local ok,err=pcall(function() local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene) PS.build({portId='london',portName='london',level=3,shipId='galleon',hasShipyard=true,facilities={'bank','guild','harbormaster'},storyCount=0,companions={}},function() end) end) local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character if c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then c.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-6,6,10)) end workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',60) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-100,330,1),Vector3.new(-100,0,0),Vector3.new(0,1,0))) return tostring(ok)..tostring(err)

local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('PortScene') if not f then return 'NOSCENE' end local h,hs={},0 local x0,x1,z0,z1=1e9,-1e9,1e9,-1e9 for _,d in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('Humanoid') and d.Parent:IsA('Model') then table.insert(h,d.Parent:GetPivot().Position) end if d:IsA('Model') and (d:GetAttribute('BuildType')=='house' or d:GetAttribute('BuildType')=='residence') then hs+=1 local p=d:GetPivot().Position x0=math.min(x0,p.X) x1=math.max(x1,p.X) z0=math.min(z0,p.Z) z1=math.max(z1,p.Z) end end local pr=0 for i=1,#h do for j=i+1,#h do local v=h[i]-h[j] if v.X*v.X+v.Z*v.Z<2.25 then pr+=1 end end end local a=function(k) return tostring(f:GetAttribute(k)) end local t='london_L3 npc='..#h..' 겹친쌍='..pr..' 막힘='..a('NpcRouteBlocked')..'/'..a('NpcRouteChecked')..' 옮김='..a('PropOverlapMoved')..' 숨김='..a('PropOverlapHidden')..'/'..a('PropOverlapChecked')..' 집='..a('CityHousingPlaced')..'(모델 '..hs..')'..'
